not_absolute: Enter the full path of a folder, starting with / (or a drive letter on Windows).
same: That is the folder in use already.
nested: The new folder must not lie inside the current one, nor the current one inside the new one.
not_a_folder: There is a file of that name there, not a folder.
not_writable: vinyl-check may not write to {path}. Choose another folder or allow writing there.
not_writable_service: The service may not write to {path}. Once, on the station: sudo install -d -o vinylcheck -g vinylcheck {path}

relink_missing.one: {n} file is not in the new folder (e.g. {first}): the data is not there yet.
relink_missing.other: {n} files are not in the new folder (e.g. {first}): the data is not there yet.

conflicts.one: {n} file in the new folder has the same name but a different size (e.g. {first}). Choose an empty folder or clean it up first.
conflicts.other: {n} files in the new folder have the same name but a different size (e.g. {first}). Choose an empty folder or clean it up first.

no_space: Not enough space: {need_gb:.1f} GB needed (including the minimum free space), {free_gb:.1f} GB free.

outside.one: {n} file lies outside the user-data folder and stays where it is.
outside.other: {n} files lie outside the user-data folder and stay where they are.

drive_required: The folder is on the drive {mount}: while that drive is not mounted, the station does not record, so nothing lands on the system disk by mistake.
copy_differs: The copy of {name} differs from the original.
busy: A move of the user-data folder is already running.
recording: A recording is running: move the folder afterwards.
busy_recording: The user-data folder is being moved: recording is possible again once the move is done.
busy_master: The user-data folder is being moved: upload the master once the move is done.

outside_missing.one: {n} file the database refers to outside the user-data folder cannot be found and stays as it is.
outside_missing.other: {n} files the database refers to outside the user-data folder cannot be found and stay as they are.

rename_analysing: An analysis is running: rename the files once it is done.
